scoring_notes: Anchor target IS the composite. Spec adjustments create axis spread around the composite. Weighted average of axis scores = target. Q/D balanced because frame material quality and seal longevity are equally critical. Performance gets 0.30 because measurable NFRC specs (U-factor, SHGC, DP rating) create real differentiation.

calibration_products.name: Marvin Ultimate (Signature Ultimate)
calibration_products.rationale: Ultrex pultruded fiberglass exterior (8x stronger than vinyl, 87% less thermal expansion). Wood interior (VG Douglas fir available). Cardinal LoE coatings. AmesburyTruth hardware. Single-factory Warroad MN. Matt Risinger and pro installer consensus: top overall. CR highest rated.

calibration_products.name: Loewen
calibration_products.rationale: Canadian premium. Douglas fir/mahogany wood with extruded aluminum cladding. Single-factory Steinbach Manitoba. Exceptional wood craftsmanship. Premium hardware. Pro consensus: top tier for wood quality but wood frame requires more maintenance than fiberglass composites.

calibration_products.name: Andersen E-Series
calibration_products.rationale: Wood interior with extruded aluminum cladding. Massive scale, nationwide availability. Strong warranty. Pro-ranked alongside Marvin/Loewen at top. Multi-plant manufacturing — minor quality variance risk vs single-factory brands. ENERGY STAR Most Efficient.

calibration_products.name: Pella Architect Series
calibration_products.rationale: Wood or fiberglass (Impervia line). Industry-leading warranty coverage. 200+ showrooms for service. Innovation focus. Pros rate high for availability and support but slightly below Marvin/Loewen for pure construction quality.

calibration_products.name: Milgard Tuscany (Vinyl)
calibration_products.rationale: MI Windows subsidiary. Fusion-welded vinyl. Decent mid-tier. Full lifetime warranty (glass breakage included — unusual). West Coast dominant. Pros accept for mid-range but note vinyl limitations (thermal expansion, appearance).

calibration_products.name: JELD-WEN V-2500 (Vinyl)
calibration_products.rationale: Builder-grade vinyl. Multi-plant manufacturing with documented quality variance. Class-action lawsuit history (seal failures). Fusion-welded corners but thin vinyl profile. Contractors use for cost builds but pros warn of 10-year seal failure rates. AuraLast wood treatment on Siteline questioned.
